p.src: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

en: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

p.src: 1  How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!

en: How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!
u.src: 1  How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!

p.src: 2  My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

en: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
u.src: 2  My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

p.src: 3  Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.

en: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.
u.src: 3  Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.

p.src: 4  Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

en: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
u.src: 4  Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

p.src: 5  Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

en: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
u.src: 5  Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

p.src: 6  Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

en: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
u.src: 6  Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

p.src: 7  They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

en: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
u.src: 7  They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

p.src: 8  LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

en: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
u.src: 8  LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

p.src: 9  Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

en: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
u.src: 9  Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

p.src: 10  For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

en: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
u.src: 10  For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

p.src: 11  For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

en: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
u.src: 11  For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

p.src: 12  LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

en: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
u.src: 12  LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
